author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

prior_artefact.note: that digest is the SHA-256 of the FILE CONTENT. It is not a Git object name -- `git cat-file -t` rejects it. Recorded explicitly because a bare 64-hex string is easily mistaken for a commit.
prior_artefact.status: preserved unchanged; this artefact completes and corrects it

CORRECTION_parameter_provenance.why: the prior artefact described every generator parameter as derived from the frozen contract. Two of them are design choices ANCHORED to it, which is a weaker and more honest claim. A reviewer asking where the factor 3 or the 135 degrees came from must not find them described as deductions.

min_anchor_turn_deg.justification: directly the frozen G10 qualifying-turn magnitude; not a new choice

min_anchor_separation_m.justification: expressed as 3 x that separator so a separator run has room to be entered and left. The factor 3 is a choice, not a deduction: 2x would leave a separator with no margin either side, and larger factors reduce how many routes a scene can supply. It is declared before evaluation and is not adjusted from any outcome.

max_anchor_separation_m.justification: 4 legs at up to 9 m sum to 36 m, inside the frozen max_path_m of 40 m with margin for per-leg planning to depart from straight lines. The bound is set by the frozen route-length ceiling; the specific value is a choice within it.

max_anchor_turn_deg.justification: justified by the independent corridor/reversal control, which showed the generator emitting 3 m out and 3 m back -- a 180 degree bend that is a reversal along the same corridor, not a region transition. 135 degrees admits an acute corner between corridors and excludes a reversal. The specific value is a choice; the NEED for an upper bound is a control finding.

FROZEN_seed.rationale: matches the earlier Hospital route populations, so results are comparable

rng_sources.numpy: np.random.default_rng(seed) -- the only RNG the generator consumes
rng_sources.framework_rng: not used; generation is pre-simulation and consumes no Isaac RNG

FROZEN_seed.reproducibility_control: same seed + same scene/map/config yields identical candidate descriptors (test G)

FROZEN_candidate_budget.rationale: direct comparability with the earlier Hospital populations, which were 96
forbidden: increasing the budget after seeing failures

FROZEN_candidate_ordering.rule: seeded generation order; candidate i is the i-th route the frozen generator emits

requirements: pose free on the inflated occupancy grid (footprint does not overlap blocking geometry)
clearance >= min_clearance_m = 0.35 on the clearance transform
supported ground under the full footprint (G3 for the start, G6 for the goal)
start-goal separation >= 5.0 m, the frozen G10 threshold
a route reachable under the declared per-leg planner
connected navigable structure sufficient for the full anchor sequence

kept_separate.START_GOAL_ELIGIBLE: the pose pair satisfies the above
kept_separate.MULTI_LEG_ROUTE_GENERATION_SUCCESS: the generator placed all anchors under spacing and bend rules
kept_separate.G10_PLAN_PASS: the resulting route contains >= 3 qualifying plan turn events

FROZEN_start_goal_eligibility.why_separate: collapsing them would make a generation failure indistinguishable from an ineligible pose or a plan that simply lacks turns
FROZEN_start_goal_eligibility.forbidden: choosing a start/goal pair because a previewed route passes G10

production_selection_rule: first candidate in frozen ordering satisfying every pre-motion gate
after_this_point: no generator parameter changes from controller-fixture results. The controller fixtures that follow are NON-PRODUCTION and cannot feed back into the generator.
hospital_authorisation: NOT YET -- conditional on the controller-interface positive control
